questions.question:
**Select the appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Generous
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **miserly**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Generous**: one who is kind-hearted.

 
 
• For example: Ravi is a **generous** person.
 
 
 
• **Miserly:** one who shows an unwillingness to share with others.
 
• From the above meaning, we can infer that **'Miserly'** is the antonym of **'Generous'.**

**Therefore**, the correct answer is: **Miserly.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Charitable**: relating to the assistance of those in need.
 
• **Honest**: truthful and sincere.
 
• **Big-hearted**: kind.

questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

"What an enormous pumpkin!", said the boy.

options.text: The boy exclaimed with surprise what an enormous pumpkin it was.
The boy exclaimed with surprise that it was an enormous pumpkin.
The boy exclaimed with horror what an enormous pumpkin was it.
The boy asked what an enormous pumpkin was it.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **The boy exclaimed with surprise that it was an enormous pumpkin**.**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is **exclamatory.**
 
• Exclamatory phrases are used to communicate abrupt outbursts of emotions like **surprise, excitement, disdain, and joy**.
 
• When used in indirect speech, the exclamatory word or phrase is changed to **"exclaimed with delight, grief, regret, astonishment, scorn, etc."**
 
• The sentence in the direct speech is in the **present tense**. Hence, the sentence in the indirect speech should be in the **past tense**.
 
• Example:
 
 
• **Direct speech:** The girl said, "Wow! What a beautiful dress".
 
• **Indirect Speech: **The girl exclaimed with joy that it was a beautiful dress. 
 
 
 
• In the given context, the boy was **surprised at the enormous size of a pumpkin**.

Hence, the correct indirect speech of the given sentence is **The boy exclaimed with surprise that it was an enormous pumpkin.**
